title: Whatever happened to the Harappan Civilisation?

sentences.en: New research sheds light on the disappearance of an ancient society A The Harappan Civilisation of ancient Pakistan and India flourished 5,000 years ago, but a thousand years later their cities were abandoned.
sentences.zh: 新研究揭示了古代社会的消失 A 古巴基斯坦和印度的哈拉帕文明在 5000 年前蓬勃发展,但 1000 年后他们的城市被遗弃。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: The Harappan Civilisation was a sophisticated Bronze Age society who built ‘megacities’ and traded internationally in luxury craft products, and yet seemed to have left almost no depictions of themselves.
sentences.zh: 哈拉帕文明是一个复杂的青铜时代社会,他们建造了“大城市”并在国际上进行奢侈工艺品贸易,但似乎几乎没有留下任何关于自己的描述。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: But their lack of self-imagery - at a time when the Egyptians were carving and painting representations of themselves all over their temples - is only part of the mystery.
sentences.zh: 但他们缺乏自我形象——当时埃及人在他们的寺庙各处雕刻和绘画自己的形象——只是谜团的一部分。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: B There is plenty of archaeological evidence to tell us about the rise of the Harappan Civilisation, but relatively little about its fall,’ explains archaeologist Dr Cameron Petrie of the University of Cambridge.
sentences.zh: B 有大量考古证据可以告诉我们哈拉帕文明的兴起,但有关其衰落的证据相对较少,”剑桥大学的考古学家卡梅伦·皮特里博士解释道。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: ‘As populations increased, cities were built that had great baths, craft workshops, palaces and halls laid out in distinct sectors. Houses were arranged in blocks, with wide main streets and narrow alleyways, and many had their own wells and drainage systems. It was very much a “thriving” civilisation.’ Then around 2100 BC, a transformation began.
sentences.zh: ‘随着人口的增加,城市被建造起来,在不同的区域分布着巨大的浴室、工艺作坊、宫殿和大厅。房屋呈街区状排列,主街宽阔,小巷狭窄,许多房屋都有自己的水井和排水系统。这是一个非常“繁荣”的文明。”然后在公元前 2100 年左右,一场转变开始了。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: Streets went uncleaned, buildings started to be abandoned, and ritual structures fell out of use.
sentences.zh: 街道变得不干净,建筑物开始被废弃,仪式建筑不再使用。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: After their final demise, a millennium passed before really large-scale cities appeared once more in South Asia.
sentences.zh: 在它们最终消亡之后,千年过去了,真正的大型城市才在南亚再次出现。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: C Some have claimed that major glacier-fed rivers changed their course, dramatically affecting the water supply and agriculture; or that the cities could not cope with an increasing population, they exhausted their resource base, the trading economy broke down or they succumbed to invasion and conflict; and yet others that climate change caused an environmental change that affected food and water provision.
sentences.zh: C 一些人声称,主要的冰川供水河流改变了河道,极大地影响了供水和农业；或者城市无法应对不断增长的人口,耗尽了资源基础,贸易经济崩溃,或者屈服于入侵和冲突；还有一些人认为,气候变化导致了环境变化,影响了食物和水的供应。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: 'It is unlikely that there was a single cause for the decline of the civilisation.
sentences.zh: '文明的衰落不太可能是由单一原因造成的。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: But the fact is, until now, we have had little solid evidence from the area for most of the key elements,,said Petrie.
sentences.zh: 但事实是,到目前为止,我们在该地区几乎没有获得关于大多数关键元素的确凿证据,”皮特里说。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: ‘A lot of the archaeological debate has really only been wellargued speculation.
sentences.zh: ‘许多考古学辩论实际上只是有充分论证的猜测。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: , D A research team led by Petrie, together with Dr Ravindanath Singh of Banaras Hindu University in India, found early in their investigations that many of the archaeological sites were not where they were supposed to be, completely altering understanding of the way that this region was inhabited in the past.
sentences.zh: , D 由 Petrie 领导的研究小组与印度贝拿勒斯印度教大学的 Ravindanath Singh 博士一起在调查初期发现,许多考古遗址不在其应有的位置,完全改变了对该地区过去居住方式的理解。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: When they carried out a survey of how the larger area was settled in relation to sources of water, they found inaccuracies in the published geographic locations of ancient settlements ranging from several hundred metres to many kilometres.
sentences.zh: 当他们对更大区域的定居点与水源的关系进行调查时,他们发现公布的古代定居点的地理位置不准确,范围从几百米到几千米不等。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: They realised that any attempts to use the existing data were likely to be fundamentally flawed.
sentences.zh: 他们意识到任何使用现有数据的尝试都可能存在根本性缺陷。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Over the course of several seasons of fieldwork they carried out new surveys, finding an astonishing 198 settlement sites that were previously unknown.
sentences.zh: 在几个季节的实地考察过程中,他们进行了新的调查,发现了惊人的 198 个以前未知的定居点。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: E Now, research published by Dr Yama Dixit and Professor David Hodell, both from Cambridge’s Department of Earth Sciences, has provided the first definitive evidence for climate change affecting the plains of north-western India, where hundreds of Harappan sites are known to have been situated.
sentences.zh: E Now,来自剑桥大学地球科学系的 Yama Dixit 博士和 David Hodell 教授发表的研究为气候变化影响印度西北部平原提供了第一个明确的证据,那里已知有数百个哈拉帕遗址。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: The researchers gathered shells of Melanoides tuberculata snails from the sediments of an ancient lake and used geochemical analysis as a means of tracing the climate history of the region.
sentences.zh: 研究人员从一个古老湖泊的沉积物中收集了 Melanoides tuberculata 蜗牛的壳,并使用地球化学分析作为追踪该地区气候历史的手段。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: ‘As today, the major source of water into the lake is likely to have been the summer monsoon,’ says Dixit.
sentences.zh: “就像今天一样,进入湖中的主要水源可能是夏季季风,”迪克西特说。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: ‘But we have observed that there was an abrupt change about 4,100 years ago, when the amount of evaporation from the lake exceeded the rainfall 一 indicative of a drought.’ Hodell adds: 'We estimate that the weakening of the Indian summer monsoon climate lasted about 200 years before recovering to the previous conditions, which we still see today.
sentences.zh: “但我们观察到,大约 4100 年前发生了突然的变化,当时湖泊的蒸发量超过了降雨量,这表明发生了干旱。”霍德尔补充道：“我们估计,印度夏季季风气候的减弱持续了大约 200 年,然后才恢复到以前的状况,我们今天仍然看到这种情况。”

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: , F It has long been thought that other great Bronze Age civilisations also declined at a similar time, with a global-scale climate event being seen as the cause.
sentences.zh: , F 长期以来,人们一直认为其他伟大的青铜时代文明也在类似的时间衰落,全球范围的气候事件被视为原因。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: While it is possible that these local-scale processes were linked, the real archaeological interest lies in understanding the impact of these larger-scale events on different environments and different populations.
sentences.zh: 虽然这些局部规模的过程可能是相互联系的,但真正的考古兴趣在于了解这些更大规模的事件对不同环境和不同人群的影响。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: ‘Considering the vast area of the Harappan Civilisation with its variable weather systems,’ explains Singh, ‘it is essential that we obtain more climate data from areas close to the two great cities at Mohenjodaro and Harappa and also from the Indian Punjab•’ G Petrie and Singh's team is now examining archaeological records and trying to understand details of how people led their lives in the region five millennia ago.
sentences.zh: “考虑到哈拉帕文明的广阔区域及其多变的天气系统,”辛格解释道,“我们有必要从摩亨佐达罗和哈拉帕这两个大城市附近的地区以及印度旁遮普邦获得更多的气候数据。”G Petrie 和辛格的团队现在正在检查考古记录,并试图了解五千年前人们如何在该地区生活的细节。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: They are analysing grains cultivated at the time, and trying to work out whether they were grown under extreme conditions of water stress, and whether they were adjusting the combinations of crops they were growing for different weather systems.
sentences.zh: 他们正在分析当时种植的谷物,并试图弄清楚它们是否是在极端缺水条件下生长的,以及他们是否正在根据不同的天气系统调整所种植的作物组合。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: They are also looking at whether the types of pottery used, and other aspects of their material culture, were distinctive to specific regions or were more similar across larger areas.
sentences.zh: 他们还在研究所使用的陶器类型及其物质文化的其他方面是否对特定地区而言是独特的,或者在更大的地区是否更为相似。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: This gives us insight into the types of interactive networks that the population was involved in, and whether those changed.
sentences.zh: 这让我们深入了解人们参与的互动网络的类型,以及这些网络是否发生了变化。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: H Petrie believes that archaeologists are in a unique position to investigate how past societies responded to environmental and climatic change.
sentences.zh: H Petrie 认为,考古学家在研究过去社会如何应对环境和气候变化方面处于独特的地位。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: ‘By investigating responses to environmental pressures and threats, we can learn from the past to engage with the public, and the relevant governmental and administrative bodies, to be more proactive in issues such as the management and administration of water supply, the balance of urban and rural development, and the importance of preserving cultural heritage in the future.’
sentences.zh: “通过调查对环境压力和威胁的反应,我们可以吸取过去的教训,与公众、相关政府和行政机构合作,在供水管理、城乡发展平衡以及未来保护文化遗产的重要性等问题上更加积极主动。”

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。
